# Introduction

For this assignment, you will reuse the tract-level SoVI variables from HW_02 (`data/processed/sovi_tract_2015_merged.csv`; no new data pipeline work is required) to predict tract-level life expectancy, but this time with a regression tree instead of linear regression. This assignment does not use the geography columns (`geo_lat`, `geo_lon`, etc.) at all -- every model below uses the SoVI variables only.

A single regression tree can fit the training data almost perfectly if you let it grow deep enough, which makes it a different kind of overfitting risk than the linear models from HW_02. You will watch a tree overfit, then use cross-validation with random tract-level folds (same mechanic as HW_02 Part 3) to tune the tree's depth, compare the tuned tree back to linear regression, and finally see how much simpler a tree can be when the question it's answering is simpler too.
